title: Reusable bowls at an outdoor market

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A reminder for food stall volunteers. Bowls from the return bench go into the grey rack, even if they look clean. A quick rinse removes crumbs so the rack stays tidy; it doesn't make a bowl ready to serve. Only bowls from the dishwasher go into the white rack. If it runs low, take a sealed stack from the supply tent rather than using rinsed bowls. Leave the grey rack at the bench. The wash team collects it together with the used cups.
turns.zh: 提醒餐攤志工：回收台收回的碗，即使看起來乾淨，也要放到灰色架上。快速沖水是為了除去碎屑，讓架子保持整潔，不能因此就拿碗供餐。只有經洗碗機清洗的碗才放到白色架。如果白架的碗快用完了，就從補給帳篷拿一疊封好的碗，不要用只沖過的碗。把灰架留在回收台，清洗小組會連同用過的杯子一起收走。
